recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: world cup drums echoing through mexico city plazas
crypto fortunes crystallizing overnight on digital ledgers
smoke drifting over antwerp's red brick skyline
san francisco fog lifting into a pale july afternoon
stutter-house beats pulsing through headphones on the commute
sunset not until half past eight on the bay

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house beat slices as they snap into a loop; each hit adds a layer that plays back over a foggy bay sunrise.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Build a perfect 8-bar loop before the track skips to the next bar.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and off-beat ghost notes appear between the main hits.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform wireframe on fog-blue gradient

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Swipe between three celebration lanes in a Mexico City plaza, catching confetti while dodging spilled cups as the crowd surges after each goal horn.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Survive one fever-pitch minute without dropping the flag.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Crowd density doubles and fireworks briefly obscure the lanes.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: papel picado cutouts over saturated street color blocks

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick falling crypto shards into matching wallet slots before they shatter; misaligned crystals crack and clutter the screen.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Land seven perfect deposits to mint a glowing coin.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Wallet slots rotate and shards spawn faster in odd asymmetric shapes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: holographic glass prisms on black velvet

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one continuous fog line from Twin Peaks down to the marina before the sun sets at 8:35; seagulls reroute your path if you're too slow.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Reach the water's edge with a smooth unbroken trail.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fog banks thicken and wind shears erase segments unless you redraw quickly.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor SF summer dusk bleeding orange into marine layer gray
